keyFindings.title: **CLI agreement is not ground-truth accuracy.** Hold out a frozen, domain-representative set with independent human/adjudicated choices, blind reviewers to backend, and report per-backend accuracy plus calibration and paired disagreement. keyFindings.title: **Default-on needs explicit semantics, release gates, and rollback.** Before changing the unset route, preserve the caller’s requested provider or limit Pi to an explicit compatible provider/model; the present adapter discards --provider and pins OpenRouter. Require a same-day paired run with labeled quality bounds, explicit coverage/latency/cost limits, and a bounded total timeout across Pi plus fallback. Keep an explicit CLI rollback; because the current per-call transport option takes precedence over JEV_TRANSPORT, decide precedence so an emergency environment kill switch can actually force CLI. Start with a canary over the two confirmed sk-doc choice callers and retain opt-in until the gate passes. keyFindings.title: **Fallback keeps callers operational but can add work on failure.** Missing Pi package/model/credential, classifier error, timeout, or unmappable result falls back to the CLI. The adapter makes one Pi classify call under the caller timeout and has no retry inside it; a failed Pi attempt followed by CLI can still add both request cost and elapsed time. Track success/fallback reason and total end-to-end latency, not only successful Pi latency. keyFindings.title: **Operational risk is concentrated in provider drift and fallback behavior.** Pi may not be installed, the fixed model may be unavailable, credentials may not resolve, or classify may fail; the caller then proceeds on CLI. This is resilient for output shape, but under default-on it can create repeated skip noise and add a second attempt. Require per-caller tests for all gates and the output contract, plus telemetry that avoids logging credentials or sensitive request text. The integration spec already calls for stubbed backends and a test per gate. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/cli-classifier/feature-catalog/measurements/pi-transport-integration.md:48-70] [SOURCE: specs/cli-jev/003-cli-jev-workflow-integration/038-pi-classifier-transport-integration/spec.md:89-104]

keyFindings.title: **The current answer contract catches incomplete results but leaves quality checks to measurement.** It rejects a choice outside the submitted keys and requires a finite probability for every key. It does not itself bound values to [0,1], check their sum, or check whether the selected choice matches the largest probability. Add diagnostics for these conditions and define tie handling before treating such outputs as valid; do not label those checks as accuracy without human or adjudicated truth labels. keyFindings.title: Adopt and keep-cli are statistically indistinguishable at n=111
keyFindings.text: Exact 95 percent CI: 106/111 = [89.8, 98.5]; 105/111 = [88.6, 98.0]. The rule needs a stability margin, wider measurement, or a within-noise outcome.

keyFindings.title: Agreement is a mean-of-orders construct: per-order 95.2 vs mean 95.5
keyFindings.text: rr-iter3-127 has identical per-order picks on both sides yet counts as a disagreement because averaged means cross (0.023 vs 0.010).

keyFindings.title: All five disagreements are near-ties; 99 decisive rows agree 100 percent
keyFindings.text: The disagreement set is contained in the 12 rows with either-side top-2 mean margin under 0.10; three flip on gaps under 0.07.

keyFindings.title: Catalog price table for every available classifier arm
keyFindings.text: jev-1.13 and its siblings $0.042/M in, $0 out; span-01 $0.02/M; span-01-lite and :free $0; solar-decide $0.05/M; jev-1.13-free $0 needs Zen; direct typesafe needs TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keyFindings.title: Cost figure unreproducible from the run records
keyFindings.text: cost_per_100 reads in-process usage.cost.total; calls.jsonl stores no usage, so 0.0022 lives only in report.json.

keyFindings.title: Input drift between recording and replay is undetectable
keyFindings.text: The plan checks only the option key set; neither side stores a comparable prompt digest; a prompt edit would silently compare different questions.

keyFindings.title: Margin-gated escalation is the one agreement-raising policy on record
keyFindings.text: Defer sub-0.10-margin rows (7) to the CLI: 99.1 percent agreement while Pi serves 104/111 rows; a 0.05 gate defers 2 rows for 96.4 percent.

keyFindings.title: Pi-native calls are invisible to dispatch auditing
keyFindings.text: dispatch-audit classifies jev choice|noul|score|run and jev-mcp as cli-classifier dispatches; adopting the transport narrows what the audit sees.

keyFindings.title: rr-iter3-125 CLI top is an exact tie settled by option order
keyFindings.text: system-deep-loop and none both 0.3166667; topKey keeps the earlier submitted key and none is appended last.

keyFindings.title: The default path would pay runtime construction and gates per call
keyFindings.text: createPiRuntime plus model/credential gates run per call with no caching; the measured 260 ms is the benchmark's once-per-run runtime and the transport never made a live call.

keyFindings.title: The three rotations are load-bearing for the verdict
keyFindings.text: 1 call 103/111 = 92.8; 2 calls 105/111 = 94.6; 3 calls 106/111 = 95.5. Any rotation cut flips to keep-cli.

keyFindings.title: Verdict arithmetic: 106/111 = 95.5, one row above keep-cli at 94.6
keyFindings.text: The keep rule judges coverage >= 90, agreement >= 95, latency <= 1.5x in order; adopt is one row from failure and latency/coverage never bound.
